item.description:
Build 16 is a big editing update.
- Join several ranges of a video into one loop, with smooth crossfades between them. - New Look tab: sharpen, reduce noise, and adjust contrast, saturation and brightness, with a before/after preview. - A cleaner editor: the whole video as one strip, a lane that keeps nearby ranges easy to pick, zoom, and one obvious Export button. - Preview the whole result before exporting (⇧⌘P). - Exports and progress now live together on the Exports page, and starting an export takes you straight to its progress. - A smoother playhead, a tidier Inspector, and many fixes.
Installed builds update to this one automatically (Settings → About → Automatically check for updates).
